info.name: Hotel Offer Orchestrator - assessment verification
info.description: Run every request with baseUrl=http://localhost:4000. Set supplierDown to none, A or B to match startup flags. Valid searches fail entirely with 503 during either outage; invalid searches stay 400. Supplier routes check availability before city validation. Readiness stays 200 during supplier outages. Mismatched modes fail assertions. Use a 40000 ms request timeout. See README for Docker outage/recovery commands.
